title: VestraDAO — Staking Business Logic Vulnerability Analysis (Missing isActive Validation)
loss_raw: ~73,720,000 VSTR (approx. $378,400 ~ $500,000) — swapped for 125 ETH and mixed via Tornado Cash
root_cause: Missing `isActive` state validation in `unStake()` — repeated calls on an already-unstaked position extracted 20,000 VSTR profit each time
code_before:
[Attacker EOA: 0x9543...]
         │
         │ Deploy + initial 500K VSTR stake (~1 month prior)

  └─────────┬───────────────┘
            │
            │ ① Each cycle: transfer 500K VSTR
            ▼
  ┌─────────────────────────┐
  │   SubAccount N          │◄── New account created each cycle
  │   (60 sub-accounts)     │
  └─────────┬───────────────┘
            │

            │    → maintain totalStaked (prevent underflow)

code_after: ✅ Fix — blocking the totalStaked deduction itself via isActive validation resolves this
steps: 1. Attack contract calls `unStake(positionId=100)` → receives 500,000 principal + 20,000 yield
2. Confirms immediate re-call is possible due to missing `isActive` validation
1. Attack contract → Sub-account N: transfer 500,000 VSTR
2. Sub-account N → LockedStaking: stake(500,000 VSTR) (maintain totalStaked)
3. Attack contract → LockedStaking: re-call unStake(original position)
4. LockedStaking → Attack contract: return 520,000 VSTR (500,000 + 20,000 yield)
④ Acquired VSTR → swap to ETH
